ja: 人気のＭＳＶ『機動戦士ガンダムSEED ASTRAY』より、ガンダムアストレイゴールドフレームを
最新のプロポーションと可動、ギミック構造を備えた1/144 ＨＧで商品化！
劇中の設定を成形色カラーと新規造形で再現!
● 大型のバズーカ“３５０ｍｍレールバズーカ‘ゲイボルグ’を付属
● 右腕肩部専用パーツが付属し、パーツの差し替えで劇中のシーンが再現可能
● 各関節機構は広範囲の可動域をもち、フレキシブルなポーズが可能
付属武装 ： ３５０ｍｍレールバズーカ、ビームライフル、ビームサーベル、シールド

en: Gundam Astray Gold Frame from the popular MSV "Mobile Suit GundamSEED ASTRAY"
Commercialized in 1/144 HG with the latest proportions, movement, and gimmick structure!
The setting in the play is reproduced with molded colors and new modeling!
● Includes a large bazooka “350mm rail bazooka ‘Gayborg’”
● Dedicated parts for the right arm and shoulder are included, and scenes from the play can be recreated by replacing the parts.
● Each joint mechanism has a wide range of motion, allowing for flexible poses.
Attached weapons: 350mm rail bazooka, beam rifle, beam saber, Seal
*The finished product in the photo is a painted product. (The gold part of the actual product is not plated.)
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
